Description: TTrek regional HTTP API, Lambda integration and custom domain; based on dist/api-gateway.json.

LambdaFunctionName.Description: Existing website Lambda name or ARN

CertificateArn.Description: Optional existing ACM certificate ARN in this region; otherwise import the certificate stack output.

HostedZoneId.Description: Optional public Route 53 zone ID for the apex A alias; otherwise configure DNS externally.

RegionalDomainName.Description: DNS alias target for external DNS providers.
